info.title: FarmOps Public API
info.description:
Programmatic access to FarmOps alliance data and read-only server
statistics. Alliance endpoints support imports and exports for power,
kills, Total Hero Power (THP), VS points (duels), donations, storms,
custom events, seasons, historical Train rosters, and saved Train schedules. Server endpoints expose redacted aggregate,
player-ranking, and player-history data.

## Authentication
Include your API key in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer fops_live_<your-key>
```
Every key is bound to exactly one tenant: an alliance or a server. Alliance
keys carry a `READ` or `WRITE` scope and are managed in alliance settings.
Server keys are always `READ`-only and are managed from the server's
**API Access** page by its owner or an admin. Keys are not interchangeable:
an alliance key receives `TENANT_MISMATCH` on server endpoints and vice versa.

Alliance API access requires active Alliance Pro plus active Auto Sync
access. Server API access requires an active Server Pro subscription or
trial for the key's server.

## Rate limiting
- 60 requests per minute per key
- 5 000 requests per day per key

Every response includes `X-RateLimit-Remaining-Minute` and
`X-RateLimit-Remaining-Day` headers. When exceeded you receive HTTP 429 with
a `Retry-After` header.

## Errors
All errors follow a consistent shape:
```json
{ "error": { "code": "RATE_LIMITED", "message": "...", "details": {} } }
```
Switch on `error.code` (stable) rather than `error.message`.

## BigInt values
Power, kill, Total Hero Power, VS score, and donation total counters can
exceed `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. These fields are serialised as
**strings** in JSON responses. Parse them accordingly
(`BigInt(response.power)` in JS).

## Time buckets
FarmOps day and week buckets follow the in-game reset at 02:00 UTC
(00:00 server time, UTC-2). `weekStartDay` controls the weekly bucket
boundary: `0` = Sunday, `1` = Monday. Bucket fields such as `scoredOn` and
`weekStart` are date-only keys, for example `2026-05-25`.
Historical Train dates use strict `YYYY-MM-DD` UTC calendar dates and
cannot be later than today in UTC. They do not use the 02:00 scoring reset.
Saved Train schedule ranges use the same calendar dates and also accept
future dates; they return persisted rosters only.

tags.name: Train
tags.description: Read saved Train schedules and export or atomically record historical Train rosters for the key's alliance.

details.description: Optional extra context; shape varies by error code.

ServerPlayer.description: Redacted server-player projection. Game identity and internal sync fields are omitted.

activityLogId.description: Use this to undo the import within 24h via the web UI.

TrainScheduleDate.description: Existing UTC calendar date, including future dates. Year must be 0001–9999.

TrainScheduleRecord.description: One persisted TrainAssignment roster. Missing dates and empty positions are never generated.

wagons.description: Saved occupied seats only, ordered by wagon number then position.

TrainHistoryDate.description: Existing calendar date, no later than today in UTC.

TrainHistoryVersion.description: Opaque current version from a Train history export. Do not construct it yourself.

TrainHistoryFacts.description:
One complete historical roster. Omitted invite, defender, and wagon
positions are empty; importing an existing date replaces its entire
roster. The conductor, invite, and wagon seats must each contain a
different member. The separate defender may overlap any seated role.
ACTIVE and LEFT members of this alliance are accepted, with no current
eligibility, pool, absence, or joining-date checks.

inviteType.description: Required when inviteId is present; must be null or omitted when inviteId is empty.

wagons.description: Occupied seats only. Each wagon/position pair must be unique; sparse positions are allowed.

expectedVersion.description:
Explicit null means create-only. Replacing an existing date
requires its current exported version, even when the submitted
facts are unchanged. An absent expectedVersion field is
VALIDATION_ERROR (400). Submitted null against an existing
date, or a stale or inappropriate version, rejects the entire
batch with STALE_ENTRY (409).

count.description: Number of dates in this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass as the exclusive before cursor for the next page. Null means no older dates remain.

entries.description: Unique dates only. JSON resolves members exclusively by alliance member ID.

versionMismatch.description: Successful previews have matching versions; a mismatch instead returns HTTP 409.

errors.description: Successful previews have no validation errors; invalid batches return an error response.

Format.name: format
Format.description: Override the response format. Defaults to JSON. (CSV-capable endpoints only.)

TrainHistoryIdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
TrainHistoryIdempotencyKey.description:
Unique operation ID. Keep the same key and exact payload after a failed
commit attempt; use a new key for an edited payload. Also required for
preview, which does not reserve the key or write a receipt.

RateLimitHeaders.description: Rate limit info is included in every response

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired key

Forbidden.description: Key scope/tenant mismatch, or the required tenant entitlement is missing

ValidationError.description: Request body or params failed validation

get.description:
Requires an alliance READ key (WRITE keys also allow reads), active
Alliance Pro or trial, and active Auto Sync access, using the same
authentication as Train history. Read-only alliances can read saved
schedules; the key creator does not need a current officer role.
A block present at authentication returns TRIAL_EXPIRED (403); a block
detected by the transactional state recheck returns ACCESS_BLOCKED (423).

Both `from` and `to` are required exactly once as valid `YYYY-MM-DD`
UTC calendar dates. The range is inclusive, `from` must not follow
`to`, and the range must contain at most 31 dates. Past, today, and
future dates are accepted. There is no implicit range or pagination.

Returns only persisted TrainAssignment rosters, ordered by date
ascending. Missing dates are omitted, and an unsaved range returns an
empty array. This endpoint never generates, saves, or changes Train
assignments or rotation state. Standard API access logging still runs.
Future entries describe saved plans, not confirmed historical facts.
The existing history endpoint remains limited to today and earlier.

JSON includes roster IDs, member IDs and current names, invite type,
defender, occupied wagon seats, and the existing opaque roster version.
Set `format=csv` or `Accept: text/csv` for the same occupied-position
columns as history: `date,weekType,position,memberId,name,inviteType,expectedVersion`.
CSV escapes spreadsheet formula prefixes, emits no empty positions,
and includes only the header when there are no saved rosters.
`X-Count` counts persisted dates, not CSV rows. Future schedule CSV
rows cannot be imported as historical facts while their date is future.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive first date. Required exactly once; at most 31 dates through to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive final date. Required exactly once; must be on or after from.

200.description: Persisted rosters in the explicit inclusive range, in JSON or CSV

X-Count.description: Number of persisted dates in a CSV response.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR for a missing, repeated, malformed, nonexistent, reversed, or over-31-date range.

404.description: The key's alliance no longer exists (ALLIANCE_NOT_FOUND).

423.description: A transactional state recheck detects blocked alliance data after authentication (ACCESS_BLOCKED).

get.description:
Requires an alliance READ key (WRITE keys also allow reads). Returns
complete rosters in descending date order, limited to dates no later
than today in UTC. Future planned rosters are excluded. Read-only
alliances can export; the key creator does not need a current officer
role for READ access. A block present at authentication returns
TRIAL_EXPIRED (403); a block detected by the subsequent transactional
state recheck returns ACCESS_BLOCKED (423).

JSON is the default. Set `format=csv` or `Accept: text/csv` for occupied
position rows with the headers
`date,weekType,position,memberId,name,inviteType,expectedVersion`.
CSV includes current member names for reference, retains member IDs and
versions, and escapes spreadsheet formula prefixes. Empty positions
have no row. `X-Count` counts dates, not CSV rows; `X-Next-Cursor` is
present only when older dates remain.

Fetch each page explicitly using its `nextCursor` as the exclusive
`before` date. Each response contains at most 100 dates; a single call
does not export the entire history. Exported versions are required for
subsequent replacements through POST.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of dates; values outside 1–100 are rejected.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Return dates strictly older than this UTC date. Must be a valid date no later than today.

200.description: Historical date page in JSON or CSV

X-Count.description: Number of dates in a CSV response.

X-Next-Cursor.description: Exclusive before cursor for the next CSV page; omitted when no older dates remain.

404.description: The key's alliance no longer exists (ALLIANCE_NOT_FOUND).

423.description: A transactional state recheck detects blocked alliance data after authentication (ACCESS_BLOCKED).

post.summary: Import or preview historical Train rosters
post.description:
Requires an alliance WRITE key and `Idempotency-Key`. The key creator
must currently be the alliance owner, an ADMIN, or a MANAGER; this is
checked inside the locked write transaction. Read-only alliances return
READ_ONLY. A block present at authentication returns TRIAL_EXPIRED (403);
a block detected by the subsequent transactional state recheck returns
ACCESS_BLOCKED (423). Server keys cannot call this endpoint.

Submit 1–100 unique UTC dates, up to 2 MiB of actual request body and
2,300 occupied position rows. Dates cannot be in the future. Each date
is a complete replacement: omitted roles and seats stay empty, rather
than merging with the existing roster. All dates validate and commit
atomically. Current ACTIVE and former LEFT members are accepted; current
selection rules, eligibility, absences, and joining dates do not gate
historical facts. A successful commit records an audit receipt and
rebuilds history-derived rotations. It does not create members or
regenerate planned rosters. JSON nesting deeper than 32 levels is
rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR (400).

**JSON:** use alliance member IDs only and include `expectedVersion`
for every entry. Explicit null means create-only. For any existing date,
submit the current exported 64-character version, even when its facts
are unchanged. Missing required fields are VALIDATION_ERROR; a version
conflict returns STALE_ENTRY for the whole batch. Invalid JSON batches,
including more than 100 entries, return VALIDATION_ERROR (400).

**CSV:** use exactly these seven headers:
`date,weekType,position,memberId,name,inviteType,expectedVersion`.
Positions are `CONDUCTOR`, `INVITE`, `DEFENDER`, or `WAGON:1:1` through
`WAGON:4:5`. Each date needs one conductor and one consistent PUSH/SAVE
week type and version across its rows. A blank version means create-only.
An invite row needs VIP or GUARDIAN; other rows leave inviteType blank.
A present memberId takes precedence over name; an unknown ID fails.
With an empty ID, name must exactly and unambiguously match a current
member name or alternate name in this alliance. Display aliases,
personal aliases, fuzzy matching, and member creation are unsupported.
CSV date or occupied-row limits return LIMIT_EXCEEDED (400); the actual
2 MiB body byte limit returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED (413) for either format.
Example IDs and names below are fictional; replace them with members
from your own alliance before importing.

**Preview:** `preview=true` runs the same permissions, parsing, member,
and submitted-version checks. A stale version returns HTTP 409 in preview
too. Success returns canonical ID-based entries and per-date NEW,
UNCHANGED, or REPLACE comparisons. Preview writes no history, audit, or
idempotency receipt. Review the result, then POST the same payload without
preview; versions are checked again at commit.

**Retries:** after a failed commit response, retry the same key and
payload. An already committed request returns its original receipt
before CSV member names are resolved again. JSON object-key order is
normalized; CSV identity uses the exact raw text, including whitespace
and row order. Array order and omitted versus explicit JSON fields remain
part of the payload. Reusing a committed key with an edited payload
returns REQUEST_CONFLICT. Receipts are scoped to this alliance, API key,
and trusted creator; changing any of them is a separate request. Normal
history deletion retains receipts; an alliance Reset removes them.

403.description: Wrapper scope/tenant/entitlement checks (including an authentication-time block as TRIAL_EXPIRED), current creator role (FORBIDDEN), or read-only alliance (READ_ONLY).
